notes: Coverage: the whole image was opened once for layout, followed by half_a once and half_b once in that order. Every text block, every word and ending, punctuation, accent, abbreviation, underline, insertion, deletion, quotation mark, and every inline mathematical expression was compared against both witnesses, including their agreements. There are no displayed formula blocks, diagrams, independent drawings, or margin notes on this page. This is visual transcription coverage, not a mathematical proof check.

The first recorded clock time, 11:26:19 UTC, was taken after the initial packet/brief read and before the images. Whole and half image timestamps are exact clock reads immediately before their individual tool views. Crop timestamps mark the clock read before each group of three sequential views. No source image was reopened for viewing; PIL read the whole source only to extract the nine tight crops and its dimensions.

The source is entirely manuscript text in one principal dark-pen hand. The packet does not independently establish a personal identity for that hand. The pale archive number 11 is a distinct pencil layer; there is no author page number, title-sheet date, stated page count, salutation, address, closing or signature on this page.

The example states that, for the projective-module construction described here, the construction of Mme Sinh provides a Picard champ épinglé by M,N and hence a canonical section of the middle term. These are statements on the page, not claims proved during this reading. The first abbreviated initial and the name of the middle term remain visually uncertain.

The NB asserts evident functorialities in M,N,X. The Question asks whether the exact triangle and exact sequence are known to the named compétences and whether higher variants are known. Its parenthetical proposal uses pourrait être and suggests n-champs de Picard non néc. stricts. The tentative language has been retained.

The interlinear parenthesis is attached by a curved insertion hook after the f. and before Alors. The hook is represented by inserted at that attachment, not by an independent drawing. The old short word after section and the crossed initial at Connaissent remain distinct cancelled layers.

The crop of the first reference also exposes a separate high trace after the low full stop. It is preserved at that physical position with alternatives for its identity/textual status; no semantic or mathematical role is assigned.

The small mark after et is adopted as a short dash from its isolated shaft in c07. The second reference has an independently clear closing parenthesis but no separate opening parenthesis in c08; the unmatched form alpha) is therefore preserved. Neither decision was made by completing an expected sentence or formula.

No OCR, PDF text layer, image-to-text software, external research, other page image, other reader return, or LaTeX compilation was used. No mathematical proof, re-proof, numerical computation, or formal certificate was performed, so math_checks is empty.
